notes: Solo-performer recovery for the river towns (census_river, census_wayback_river_b), Bucks County (census_bucks) and Soupçon/Starving Artist (census_named2) crawls. A solo act is kept only when the same venue and date in the raw data also lists a band from the census, or when the listing is a festival or concert series. Venue and town spellings are the census ones. Scripts are in the scratchpad solo_rb/ folder. Raw sources read: jp.json (J&P API feed, UTC times shifted to Eastern) and dl/jp2025.txt (Wayback homepages); dl/arties.txt and dl/ar_up.json; dl/hav.txt and the rb Havana text; dl/tr.txt and the rb Triumph text; dl/hvv.txt, dl/hvv*.html and the rb HVV text; dl/pv_api.json (Peddler's Village Tribe feed); dl/nhw*; dl/bh.txt, cr/bh/, rb/bh_events.tsv and the rb Birdhouse text; cr/flounder.txt; cr/rb/bands.json (Readington); cr/hvs.json (HV Stage); cr/tribe_rb_vm.json (Villa Milagro); cr/wp.html (Woolsey); cr/site alba/lebanon/invertase pages; the rb Crossing Vineyards, Washington Crossing Inn and Newtown Theatre text; soup/details.txt (Soupçon); bucks/puck.json, goblet.json, st.json (Sellersville, theater room only, not The Washington House), vault.json, the buckscountybrewery and aristaeus tribe dumps, fw/ snapshots (Free Will), dl_dt/daf*.html and dt25/dtm.html (Doylestown Arts Festival), yardley.tribe.json (Music Off Main, Johnson Hall, Langhorne Council), ntt_list.txt (Newtown Theatre). Could not use: Flemington DIY's Songkick raw was not saved (dl/sk.html is empty), so only the Soupçon-listed FDIY night was checked. The Soulstice page (cr/soul.html) is a bot-check page. The Sourland Mountain Festival, Levittown Now press, Doylestown Township PDF and Langhorne Council images were not saved as text, so those series had no performer lists to read. The one exception is Jake Thistle at the Sourland Mountain Festival (Unionville Vineyards, 2026-07-25), which the river census venue notes name as a skipped solo act; that row has no raw file behind it. Venues with nothing to add: Havana, Birdhouse, Flounder, Readington, Alba, Lebanon Pub, Invertase, Woolsey Park, Crossing Vineyards, Newtown Theatre, Free Will, Vault and Temperance House. At these, solo acts only played nights with no band, or a bill had just one act. Judgement calls: (1) Treated as festivals or series, so every solo act there counts: Peddler's Village Tunes at Noon and its Strawberry, Peach and OctoberFeast festivals, the Doylestown Arts Festival, Music Off Main and SoupSTOCK. Treated as house music, not series, so their solo acts need a band on the same day (none had one): Peddler's Village's Music at Nissley Vineyards and Local Picks at Red Fox Lounge, Crossing Vineyards' weekend music, Villa Milagro's Music at Milagro, Hopewell Valley Stage (a theatre season) and Washington Crossing Inn's holiday weekends. Rondie James (WCI, 2026-07-04) was therefore left out. (2) Separate solo sets on the same day as a band count, for example patio or Mixing Room sets at Puck and Broken Goblet and afternoon sets at Villa Milagro and HVV. (3) A person's name with no band word was taken as a solo performer, including touring headliners who may bring backing players (Albert Lee, Sue Foley, Stacy Mitchhart, Clint Holmes, Laura Jane Grace, Hailey Brinnel, Latonia Moore). Left out as unclear or not solo: anyone billed '& Friends' or 'and his band', duos, Cara Cartney's First Fridays (a duo, per the listing), Mike Estabrook's All Request Show (a rotating cast), Mike Pinto, Debra Devi, Sharon Lia, Scotty Austin, Bobby Mahoney, King Sickabilly, Xasthur, Drunken Prayer, Francie Moon, Wickerby, Denim Dennis, Lofash, Forrester Grey, King Slender, Keith Krimson, Tourne, Maggie Mae, Ruby Lou, Doc Swan, Judy Tudy, Dr. Jeff, Bethlehem Shalom, Ashton Hover, Brian Dale Allen Strouse (billed with full band), Ruby West at Shadfest (Ruby West Band), guest members of headlining bands, comedians, magicians and lectures. Kids' acts (Lolly Hopwood, listed as Kids at the arts festival) and student ensembles were also skipped, as were cancelled dates such as OctoberFeast Sunday 2026-10-11 and Tunes at Noon 2026-07-17. (4) Hubbell Benson was dropped: the river census treated him as solo, but census_bucks and census_named2 carry him as a band and a Puck listing calls him a band, so his John & Peter's dates (2025-09-26, 2026-04-11, 2026-05-01, 2026-10-17) still need a band-side decision. Behn Gillece's lone billing at Vault (2025-08-15) was left out because the Bucks census merges his duo and trio under one band name. (5) Other census files list a few of these performers as plain appearances without a solo flag. Forever King Clark is called a band in census_shore_morris. Christina Ward, Max Davey, Stella Ruze, Lia Menaker, Mandy Valentine, Mike Polizze, RW Hellborn, Avishag Cohen Rodrigues, Howard Louis and Edley O'Dowd also appear in the Philly-area census files. (6) Names were normalised: Hubble/Hubbell; Yuri Cohen = Yuri Gohen; Jake Latkas/Latakas Orrall; Willie/Willi Aust; Mikey/Mike Franz; Jonathn = Jonathan Ashe. 'Johan' at Tunes at Noon is billed only as 'Classic Ballads by Johan'. Jake Latakas Orrall appears both at J&P and at Soupçon. For Soupçon 2026-09-12 only evantr0nic is credited; an earlier listing for the same date (id 491) also named paul.giess and Jair-Rohm Parker Wells but looks superseded by id 609.
